title: Remove explicit any from one file

params.name: file
params.description: The TypeScript file to clean up.

preconditions: The file is TypeScript (.ts, .tsx, .mts, .cts) and uses explicit any at least once.
A typecheck script (scripts.typecheck), or TypeScript installed locally with a tsconfig.json.

criteria.pass: The file has zero explicit any, no new type-check suppressions, and typecheck passes.
criteria.partial: The any count dropped but not to zero, new suppressions were added, or typecheck fails.
criteria.fail: The any count did not drop, or the file was deleted.
